name: New Antioch
source:
New Antioch is an adult visual novel set in a post-apocalyptic world, millenia after an ancient, civilisation-ending conflict. Mankind has regressed into another feudal age and, amid cutthroat politics, war without end, and a mysterious reproductive crisis, is on the long road to extinction.

You are a feared enforcer in the service of a modest, yet influential mining province. You are the one they send out to confront their enemies, and send in when their pickaxes clank against...the unexpected. After injustice strikes, you are tasked in anger and desperation to infiltrate New Antioch--the capital city and crown jewel of your overlords--and see to its downfall.

In this original story, you'll come across unique factions, places, people, and stories, that contain romance, violence, and adult content.

You will decide the fate of New Antioch.

You will delve into dungeons thought lost to time.

You will discover who, or what you really are.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/TheRedMyst/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《新安条克》是一部成人视觉小说，背景设定在一场结束文明的古老冲突数千年后的后世界末日世界。人类倒退到了另一个封建时代，在残酷的政治、无休无止的战争和神秘的生育危机中，正走上漫长的灭亡之路。

你是一个令人畏惧的执法者，为一个不起眼但有影响力的采矿省服务。你是他们派出去对抗敌人的人，当他们的镐叮当作响……遇到意想不到的事情时，你就会派出去。在不公正事件发生后，你的任务是在愤怒和绝望中渗透到新安条克——你的宗主国的首都和皇冠上的明珠——并见证它的垮台。

在这个原创故事中，你将遇到独特的派系、地点、人物和故事，其中包含浪漫、暴力和成人内容。

你将决定新安条克的命运。

你将深入探索那些被认为已被时间遗忘的地下城。

你会发现你到底是谁，或者是什么。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/TheRedMyst/about]Patreon[/url]]
